_comment: This repository builds CUDA for SM70 inside a container. The development
host is macOS with no CUDA toolkit, and there is no compile_commands.json,
so clangd cannot resolve <cuda_runtime.h> or any project include. Clang
stops the translation unit at the first missing header and then reports
every later type as undeclared, producing roughly 21 findings per file
Those cascades are not defects and cannot be fixed here, because the
toolchain they need does not exist on this machine. Real compilation runs
in the SM70 container via tools/v100/build_only.sh, which fails the job on
any compiler error, so C++ correctness is still enforced, just not here.
Ignore the C++ and CUDA sources rather than dismissing the same cascade
one finding at a time. Python, shell, JSON and markdown are unaffected.
